changes_made.explanation: Normalized model names to standard format with hyphens, consolidated and normalized output descriptions, removed duplicate GPT-4o entry
Removed CHARTAF-G as it provides natural language feedback rather than automatic scoring. CHARTAF-S is the primary automatic metric that produces scalar scores for chart evaluation.
Removed generation models (Llama, Gemma) since only GPT-4o and Claude-3.5-Sonnet are used as evaluators. Simplified method descriptions and normalized model names.

guideline: Participants indicate preference between pre- and post-feedback chart generations on a 5-point scale from strongly prefer pre-feedback (-2) to strongly prefer post-feedback (+2)

overall_notes: The paper focuses on chart generation evaluation using LLMs. The CHARTAF system provides both automatic scoring (CHARTAF-S) and natural language feedback (CHARTAF-G). Human evaluation uses preference ratings on a 5-point scale. The paper introduces CHARTUIE-8K dataset for chart generation evaluation. All NLG tasks are chart/code generation related.
